summary: Executed backend + frontend validation on public URL with new pytest suites, offline upstream checks, and desktop/mobile Playwright flows. Core auth, connection CRUD, risk persistence, fail-closed paper/research behavior, and focused upstream graph tests passed.

Optionally add pytest-asyncio marker support in pytest config to avoid future async marker warnings.
Main agent should retest frontend route discoverability after navigation/search update.

Session cookie observed as Secure + HttpOnly but surfaced as SameSite=None; Partitioned in browser response path. Verify intended cookie policy at ingress/proxy layer.
Auth/register includes duplicate password-length check block; low-risk cleanup opportunity.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (critical flows passed; one navigation/search discoverability gap)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple test users via /api/auth/register for isolated auth/session tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public endpoint used: https://ai-paper-trade.preview.emergentagent.com. Desktop and mobile overflow checks passed (1920x800 and 390x844). Research/paper order failures observed were expected fail-closed behavior without FYERS/Gemini credentials.
rca of the issue: Global search only indexes sidebar groups and currently excludes Eligibility route. Automation failure came from querying 'Eligibility' in search and expecting a result link. Route itself works directly at /eligibility and via in-app eligibility link.
